A Bronx resident was arrested in Connecticut on suspicion of theft after allegedly taking 27 bottles of NyQuil and DayQuil from a CVS store. Police say the items were valued at several hundred dollars and the suspect is facing charges related to burglary. The incident has been reported by local news outlets and remains under investigation.
